title: Formulate 27 research targets for conditional kappa >= 0.0035
body:
Formulate 27 explicit research targets for conditional integer-multiplication kappa >= 0.0035, organized by proximity to actual retained constructions. Each full statement specifies a concrete physical mathematical construction, a quantitative complete target/paid budget, its still-open complementary supplier and the full uniform compiler/precision/outer join. No conjecture is asserted true, proved, disproved or numerically tested.

The atlas has eight native-provider targets, eight controller/interface targets, eight structural targets and three additional BIT targets. It prioritizes causal query relations, completed-helper reuse, commuting windows, complementary-sector queries, actual B/C boundary compression and multi-epoch BIT capture kernels. More distant targets cover reciprocal displacement records, code-resident services, productive spectral extensions, new reciprocal geometry and interacting tensor-E8 correction. Related alternatives are cross-referenced rather than advertised as independent discoveries.

A critical prerequisite is explicit: the selected ordinary BIT saving 0.0034 and the newer PR5512 component 0.003483969976 are both below 0.0035. Gaussian entries therefore include an OPEN ordinary-BIT companion at 0.0037; BIT entries include an OPEN complete Gaussian companion at 0.0036. These are parts of the conjectured packages, not silently assumed theorems. All conclusions retain the selected five framework assumptions. The exact new outer predicates, physical operators, independent inputs, full bills and finite reserves remain part of each full statement.

Adds seven Markdown documents: an attainable-first index, common sufficiency contract with the full PR5413 invoice and conservative 64-H1-per-local planning budget, four question volumes, and an offline coverage/credit map. No numerical searches, solvers, web searches, remote PR refreshes, mathematical replays or Lean checks were performed. The survey uses locally retained canonical commit 5e0052ca0aa3036a3afa8b0438927377c8d97d53 and cached PR descriptions; it does not claim every current comment, head or unpublished branch was covered. No new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

Credit Ali Romman; Cinna Davis / 1337isnot1337; Cao Yifan / intqwq; Dillon Amburgey / dillona; Chris R / Clear1nsight; THU New Media Research Center / thu-nmrc; ai-nanachi; DreamingOfClouds; DaysSky; GamingPuzzled; zxv; Jacob Alan Sussman; Dugongue; eumemic; Nick Petalas; Ryanson Jonathan; Gareth Davidson / bitplane; David Arias; rohanarun; the source-specific reciprocal/native, geometry, Clifford, compiler, precision, stock, routing and analytic authors. Sources.md and each volume retain specific PR roles and distinguish source-level reading from retained PR descriptions. The extra helper-frame premises of PR5553/PR5561 are stated, not granted. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance from one coordinator and three workers.

Start with README.md and sufficiency-contract.md. Every full X includes its named companion and compatibility A; a core alone is deliberately not represented as sufficient for the whole target. Only research/kappa-0035-target-atlas is added.
